question: What is the monthly payment deadline for public market stall rentals, and what penalties are imposed for delinquent payment?
answer:
The monthly payment for public market stall rentals is due and payable within the first twenty (20) working days of the month. Failure to pay the rental within the required period will subject the Lessee/Occupant to a surcharge [S1]. The exact penalty for delinquency is not specified in the provided source, but the text mentions a surcharge.

Citation: [S1] City Treasurer's CGD_Citizen Charter 2026_VOL.I & II-2.pdf | printed page 200 | chunk DEV120-CTO-PDF0045-C001, Section 349.

ground_truth: Monthly market stall rentals are due within the first 20 days of each month. Late payments incur a 25% surcharge on the rental fee plus an interest of 2% per month, not to exceed 36 months.
